Undo parent for MultipleParentsClassLoader (#2312)

66998ea7f81c6adf49983cea081586e19760b7a0 inadvertently undid a change from 9bc9be6d0fb1809346dcd02b22ced477816e0fc1, which breaks behavior under some classloaders that special case mockito classes. Use of an explicit parent with `MultipleParentsClassLoader` appears to be discouraged in the documentation also.

Co-authored-by: Tim van der Lippe <tvanderlippe@google.com>
